# Helvety Tasks

> Stage-based Helvety Tasks board with encrypted titles, descriptions, and schedule fields. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Product behavior
- Stage-based tasks with encrypted titles, descriptions, and dates
- Shareable links use `?item=<uuid>` to open a task in the detail sheet after sign-in and vault unlock
- Optional cross-app links to Helvety Contacts, Notes, and Links when those apps are in use

## Canonical URL
- [Tasks App](https://helvety.com/tasks): Auth-required task management route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Tasks routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
